{{Top|leg}}
The '''Personality Series ChaumScanner 5''' was a model of [[Poison/Legends|poison]] [[Sensor/Legends|detector]] manufactured by [[zZip Product Concepts Limited]]. It came in both a standard and luxury version, and cost 6,540 credits. A customized version of this poison detector was used in the creation of [[Rivoche Tarkin's brooch]].
